sources: recreation.gov public search API, per-site catalog for facility 10110663

values.note: $15 a site (standard and pull-through alike); $5 per vehicle after two; Scan and Pay adds a $1.50 service fee and pays one night at a time. Non-campers pay $10 to use the dump stations.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/lolo/recreation/quartz-flat-campground ('Single Site: $15 per night', 'Extra Vehicle Fee: $5 per additional vehicle(s) (after two vehicles)', 'Cost is $15 per site with a $1.50 service fee', 'Non-campers must pay $10.00 to use the dump stations') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10110663/rates (Peak Season 2026-05-21 to 2026-09-07: single site $15, pull-through $15), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: recreation.gov public search API for facility 10110663 (all 76 catalogued sites STANDARD NONELECTRIC or RV NONELECTRIC), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Three paved loops; 6 pull-through sites in Loop A for vehicles over 35 ft. 14-ft height limit in the tunnel under I-90 that links the two sides of the campground. No overflow parking.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/lolo/recreation/quartz-flat-campground ('There are 78 sites in total and 6 pull-through sites in Loop A for vehicles larger than 35 feet in length. There is no overflow parking.', 'The maximum height restriction in the center of the tunnel is 14 feet.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Flush toilets and dump stations in Loops C and G; vault toilets, water and a host in every loop.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10110663 ('Each loop has vault toilets, potable water, a Camp Host, and trash services. Loop C and Loop G have dump stations and flush toilets.') + Forest Service page ('Potable water is available', 'RV dump station available'), read 2026-10-22

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/lolo/recreation/quartz-flat-campground (Seasons of Use: 'Open May 21, 2026 - September 8, 2026.'; page last updated September 15, 2026), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Reservable: the even-numbered sites in Loops A and G and sites 1-12 in Loop C; every other site first-come (the Forest Service page also opens 'The campground is first-come, first-served'). Scan and Pay at the fee station via the Recreation.gov app.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/lolo/recreation/quartz-flat-campground ('Reservable sites in Loop A and G are all the even numbered sites. Loop C reservable sites are 1 through 12. All remaining site are first-come, first-served.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10110663 (same; notice 'The maximum stay limit is 16 days per reservation'; rule maxConsecutiveStay 16) + recreation.gov catalog (40 sites reservable, 36 not), read 2026-10-22

note: Lolo NF, ~11 mi E of Superior off I-90; enter through the Quartz Flats State Rest Area (MP 58). Paved loops in pines above the Clark Fork (Loop A overlooks the river, no river access); a lot of I-90 and train noise, especially in Loop G. Self-guided nature trail. --Claude
summary: Forest Service page + recreation.gov (Forest Service, Superior RD; mixed reservable/FCFS): confirmed $15, no electric, 78 sites with pull-throughs, vault+flush toilets, water, dump, recreation.gov with some FCFS; added season May 21 - Sep 8 (2026), 16-night limit, which sites are reservable. No alerts. Note: dropped the '~30 ft max trailer' claim (no official source; the pull-throughs take rigs over 35 ft) and restated values.
